gloss: lending and borrowing; debts and credits

definitions.explanation: The act of lending and borrowing, taken together. Often used of money or favors, and of keeping such accounts balanced between people.

examples.japanese: {友達|ともだち}とのお{金|かね}の{貸|か}し{借|か}りはしない。
examples.english: I don't lend or borrow money with friends.

examples.japanese: {貸|か}し{借|か}りはきちんと{記録|きろく}しておく。
examples.english: I keep proper records of what is lent and borrowed.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}とは{貸|か}し{借|か}りがないので、{気持|きも}ちよく{付|つ}き{合|あ}える。
examples.english: I owe him nothing and he owes me nothing, so we can get along comfortably.

notes:
Compound of {貸|か}し (lending) + {借|か}り (borrowing). Refers to the two-way relationship of debts and credits, whether of money or of favors.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {貸|か}し{借|か}りがない: to be even; owe nothing either way
- お{金|かね}の{貸|か}し{借|か}り: lending and borrowing of money

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {借金|しゃっきん}: debt — only the borrowed (owed) side
- {貸|か}し: a loan given; a favor owed to oneself
